reason: I need a clean full-site capture at handover, not a dated record that re-shoots every page daily or weekly, so a monthly subscription is paying for monitoring I'd never use. The free 15-page tier probably covers most of my small client sites anyway, and with zero reviews I wouldn't put my card in for a tool nobody has vouched for.
objection: It's built around ongoing monitoring and a monthly bill, but my use is occasional. On top of that it's brand new with no reviews and no proof it handles real sites with sticky headers, lazy-loaded images and cookie banners, so even the $79 lifetime deal feels like a bet the company will still be around.
would_change_my_mind: A pay-per-site option (a few dollars per full-site capture, no subscription), backed by real reviews from other freelancers showing it works on messy real-world sites.
